paragraphs: Chanan the tailor “taught Rav Yosef a law in HaTekhelet.” It is not there, but in Avodah Zarah 39a: Rav Huna bar Minyomi [source הונע] bought tekhelet from the household of Rav Amram the Pious. He asked Rav Yosef, who had no answer in hand. Chanan the tailor met him and said to Rav Huna, “How would poor Yosef know? ... I asked, etc.” See there.
